_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + annotated images. Tibia 7.4-era vanilla; verify on Rivalia. The 'Level 1' route bypasses the switch-tile barrier on the northern Rookgaard bridge by going through a hidden underground cave. A ROPE is mandatory — several transitions are rope-up holes, not ladders.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords (format in text is minimap 125.xx 125.yy z, not raw). z = floor (7=ground; higher z = deeper). 'down' = descend (pitfall/ladder). 'rope-up' = ascend via a rope spot (needs a Rope). 'up' = ascend via ladder.
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. Cave maps: yellow circle = current/entry hole or key ladder, green circle = target next hole/ladder. Note the route ZIG-ZAGS up and down floors — it is NOT monotonic descent.

route: Rookgaard town → West Rookgaard wilderness (Level 1 bypass)
from: Rookgaard town (through the barn, NE of the wheat field)
to: Western Rookgaard wilderness (surface), bypassing the north-bridge switch-tile barrier

start.note: Pitfall NE of the wheat field, behind the Rookgaard barn. Text minimap coords ~125.76 125.176 7 (floor 7).

min_level_note: Any level CAN take it (built for level 1s to skip the bridge barrier), but NOT advised solo/underprepared. Poison Spider poison is lethal to low levels. Bring a ROPE (required) + Antidote or several Small Health Potions. Cave holds Rats, Spiders, Bugs, Poison Spiders, Trolls; Wolves/Snakes at the exit.
requirements: Antidote Potion or Small Health Potions (recommended)

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: Go through the Rookgaard barn and step onto the PITFALL north-east of the wheat field to drop into the cave. (Pitfall marked by the X on the gif.)

steps.heading: SW
steps.text: Follow the cave SOUTH-WEST and take the ladder down. A single Spider waits below.

steps.heading: W
steps.text: ROPE UP the hole on the WEST side of the room (needs Rope). Another Spider up here. This rope hole intentionally blocks ropeless newcomers from getting stuck.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: Go down the ladder to the NORTH-WEST. A single Poison Spider spawns here.

steps.heading: SW then N then SE
steps.text: ROPE UP the hole on the SOUTH-WEST end of the room (yellow circle = the rope hole; green circle = where you land / next target). Face a Rat + one or more Spiders and Bugs. Do NOT go south into the spider/bug cave — instead go NORTH and follow the cave around, turning SOUTH-EAST when you can, to a ladder by a warning sign.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: At the ladder by the 'DANGER! Only experienced adventurers should proceed from here.' sign, go DOWN. On landing you see a Dead Human (contains Leather Legs). To the EAST is a Troll and 2 ladders down — take the EASTERN ladder.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Go down the EASTERN ladder (yellow circle) into the troll cave. Green circle marks the next objective.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: In the troll cave go NORTH and down the stairs. This is the HARDEST part of the cave.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: DANGER FLOOR: you may drop in among 3 Poison Spiders; floor holds 3 Spiders + 6 Poison Spiders total. Get to the NORTH-WEST end and go UP the ladder (green circle on Map_4). Poison here is deadly for low levels — use Antidote/heal.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: This floor has a few Trolls. Follow the cave ALL THE WAY NORTH and go UP the ladder.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: Go NORTH-EAST to the next ladder. Face a few Trolls and a Spider, then go UP.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: Go NORTH-WEST. IGNORE the ladder DOWN — instead take the next ladder UP to the surface. (Easy to mis-take the down ladder here.)

steps.heading: S
steps.text: You surface in the WESTERN Rookgaard wilderness (~125.58 125.91 7) among a bunch of Spiders — the barrier is now behind/bypassed. To reach the EAST part, cross the bridge at the top of the mountain to the SOUTH.
